task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(0.642)|0> and RY(1.524)|0>. Compare the estimate from 16384 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((0.642-1.524)/2). Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
